## Checklist

- [ ] `php bin/check.php --docker` passes.
- [ ] Each image has an exact version tag.
- [ ] A changed template has a higher `version` and a new `whats_new`.
- [ ] I made an app from this file on a FlyWP server ("Paste a file"), and `first_steps` is correct.
- [ ] The licence of the app lets customers host it (`licence`, `licence_note`).
- [ ] I can use the logo (the logo of the project, at most 100 KB).
